key.name: three-finger-drag
key.description: Drag with three fingers on the touchpad. When off, three-finger gestures are left to GNOME Shell

key.name: drag-speed
key.description: Multiplier applied to the normal pointer speed while dragging with three fingers (1.0 = same as one-finger pointer movement)

key.name: drop-delay
key.description: Milliseconds to keep holding after the fingers lift, so they can be repositioned to continue the drag with three fingers. Any other input (pointer motion, scrolling, clicks, other finger counts, key presses) drops immediately (0 = drop the moment the fingers lift)

key.name: nautilus-swipe-back
key.summary: Swipe back and forward in Files
key.description: Swipe two fingers to the right in Files (Nautilus) to go back, or to the left to go forward, with the folder sliding like a page

key.name: nautilus-touch-swipe
key.description: Swipe one finger in from the left edge of the folder view on a touchscreen in Files (Nautilus) to go back, or from the right edge to go forward, with the folder sliding like a page. Needs GNOME 49 or later

key.name: nautilus-navigation-animation
key.summary: Animate back and forward in Files
key.description: Slide the folder like a page when going back or forward in Files (Nautilus) with its back and forward buttons, Alt+Left and Alt+Right, or a mouse's side buttons
